text: 4 month old daughter has chickenpox, been itchy and scratching at the blisters but honestly fine in herself, feeding and smiling. thing is tonight i spotted a few different marks on her back, flat little dark purple dots not like the pox ones. pressed a glass on them because i remembered that from somewhere and they didn't fade at all. haven't slept in two days so maybe i'm seeing things but they're definitely still there
